newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity adds three annuity investment portfolios.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity adds three annuity investment portfolios.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said its life insurance unit has added three variable annuity investment portfolios to its offerings.
The three are VIP III Growth Opportunities, managed by George Vanderheiden; VIP III Growth & Income Portfolio, managed by Beth Terrana; and VIP III Balanced Portfolio, managed by Bettina Doulton.
All three annuities are managed by veteran Fidelity mutual fund managers.

Fidelity Investments Life Insurance Co (FILI) also offers other insurance products, including life insurance. With the addition of the three portfolios, FILI, which manages a total of $7 billion, offers 13 variable annuity investment portfolios for retirement accounts.
